en.title: The Dark Side of Politics: Why Struggles for Power Turn Disagreement into Hatred
en.deck: A historical, philosophical, psychological and political-economic investigation into collective identity, resentment, democratic rivalry and polarization in Brazil and across the world.
en.regime: Identity-based political conflict and declining intergroup trust
en.key_risk: Confusing policy disagreement with group-based dehumanization and attacks on democratic legitimacy
en.search_text: Political hostility, affective polarization, social identity theory, Brazil 2026, political economy, resentment and algorithmic amplification.

pt-BR.title: O lado sombrio da política: por que a disputa pelo poder transforma divergências em ódio
pt-BR.deck: Uma investigação histórica, filosófica, psicológica e de economia política sobre identidade coletiva, ressentimento, disputa democrática e polarização no Brasil e no mundo.
pt-BR.regime: Conflito político identitário e deterioração da confiança entre grupos
pt-BR.key_risk: Confundir divergência programática com desumanização coletiva e contestação da legitimidade democrática
pt-BR.search_text: Hostilidade política, polarização afetiva, identidade social, Brasil 2026, economia política, ressentimento e algoritmos.

research_question: Why do political differences become interpersonal hatred and how are social identity, economic insecurity, institutions and media systems transmitted into affective polarization?
assumptions_and_limits: Datafolha 2026 measures perceived polarization rather than direct personal hostility.
The 2022 electoral vote margin does not measure affective polarization.
US and Brazilian polls have different questions and samples and are not merged into a common index.
Classical theories inform mechanisms but are not 2026 quantitative evidence.
Platform experiments differ in treatment, duration and outcomes.
counterfactuals: Polarization may persist without a major economic shock.
Reducing exposure to like-minded posts need not reduce measured polarization.
Perceived hostility may exceed actual policy disagreement.
source_integrity: Direct links to TSE, MPF, OECD, Pew, peer-reviewed papers and dated Datafolha reports; observational claims distinguished from experiments.

producer_checks.content_depth: EN/PT-BR both exceed 4,000 approximate raw words and 3,700+ substantive words
producer_checks.bilingual_visuals: two source-based charts, two tables, flow and map per locale
producer_checks.scope: political economy, psychology, social identity, institutions, digital platforms, Brazil and cross-regional comparison
producer_checks.falsification: explicit observations that would weaken major mechanisms
